elevate.move: Make contrast part of the spec-sheet grammar: every dark 'title-block' row (price table head, sheet head, swatch caption) uses one shared deep-band component with bone ink and amber values, so no section style can repaint its text grey again

Give each tool section a drawing-sheet grid: the drawing column is sticky and top-aligned with the heading (estimator plan and RV pad pinned at top: header + 24px while the controls scroll past), so the plan and the controls always fill the same rows and no column ever sits empty beside the other
